record.question: Punishment for illegal possession in small quantity for personal consumption of any intoxicating liquor is _______.
options: imprisonment for a term of not less than 10 days which may extend to one month with a fine of not less than five hundred rupees which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
imprisonment for a term of not less than 15 days which may extend to one month with a fine of not less than five hundred rupees which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
imprisonment for a term of not less than 30 days which may extend to one month with a fine of not less than five hundred rupees which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
imprisonment for a term of not less than 5 days which may extend to one month with a fine of not less than five hundred rupees which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both
record.explanation: Small-quantity personal consumption of intoxicating liquor carries 10 days to one month imprisonment and Rs 500-1000 fine.
